Keep moving...
Oct 2026 • Couples
Positive point: pleasant staff. Except, surely the manager, who just comes to collect her bills at the end of the meal. 
The egg rolls for an appetizer are good.

Negative point...: 
- my partner had pork bun cha... the pork meat is DISGUSTING... it was very tough, tasted like spoiled meat, and it was full of hair. 
- tips are mandatory and mentioned directly on the bill to be paid (I would have tipped in any case, but the fact that it's mandatory when we were disappointed...) 
- I had beef, but I had to hunt for the pieces of beef (garnished with two raw onions.... What for?) 
- very expensive meal for what it is (very little on the plate). We ate for much less elsewhere and had excellent food. 

Madam manager, I am sorry, but your little smile at the register (perhaps to check the payment) as well as your 2 complimentary bottles of water did not manage to charm us...
